details:
PROJECT ASTRA is an AI-powered space mission training and operations platform designed to make space exploration education more accessible and interactive.

The platform combines three major components:

  1. Astronaut Training Centre: Provides interactive educational training scenarios related to astronaut operations, planetary exploration and simulated emergency situations.
  2. AI Mission Control: Provides a centralized dashboard to monitor simulated mission telemetry, including oxygen levels, temperature, battery status, power generation and mission events.
  3. Planetary Digital Twin: Provides an interactive digital representation of Moon and Mars environments, including research habitats, planetary terrain and life-support systems.

ASTRA AI acts as an educational assistant to help users understand space science, mission systems and simulated telemetry.

The platform is developed using modern web technologies, including TypeScript, JavaScript, React and Vite, along with supporting libraries and tools used in the implementation.

Our goal is to create an educational environment where students can explore astronaut operations, understand planetary habitats and learn about the engineering challenges of future human space exploration.

The prototype uses simulated data for demonstration purposes and is not connected to actual NASA spacecraft or planetary hardware.
